title: feat(types,react)!: a node slot and SchemaRenderer's `schema` prop take the declared-node union, V1 (objectui#11466)
body:
Part of #11466. This PR carries ruling ① (V1) and the card's residue except two items that need a decision first: the plugin-dashboard producers (objectui#11479's Q1) and objectui#11483's limit closure. "Needs a decision" below has the details. Until then `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`'s type-check reads 8 lines and `check:doc-snippets` refuses 2 blocks at this head, so the PR stays a draft.

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What changes

- `@object-ui/types` exports `DeclaredNode`. It is the discriminated union, keyed by the literal `type`, of:
  - every component schema `AnySchema` declares, minus its `BaseSchema` arm (whose `type` is `string`) and minus the app-level document, which is left out by `{ type: 'app' }` (`AppSchemaRenderer` reads that document structurally and `ComponentRegistry` never dispatches it);
  - every spec-declared `AuthoringNode`;
  - every entry of the new `CustomNodeRegistry` interface. An entry joins under its KEY: the arm is the entry intersected with `{ type: KEY }`, so even a loose entry adds no `type: string` arm.
- `SchemaNode` is `DeclaredNode | string | number | boolean | null | undefined`. It was `BaseSchema | string | number | boolean | null | undefined`.
- `SchemaRendererProps['schema']` is `DeclaredNode | string | null | undefined`. It was `BaseSchema | AuthoringNode | string | null | undefined`. `toRenderableSchema` follows by reference.
- `@object-ui/core`'s schema builder takes `DeclaredNode` where it took `BaseSchema`: `.child()` and `.children()` on the grid and flex builders, and the card builder's `.content()`.
- `@object-ui/components`' `kind: 'html'` page crosses its runtime-parsed tree into `DeclaredNode` at ONE documented boundary, right after `validateTree` reports no error (`page.tsx`, Q2 A). No other cast to `DeclaredNode` exists under `src/`.
- `@object-ui/test-support` gains `undeclaredNode`, the one crossing for deliberately undeclared test input (Q3 A). It has 25 call sites in 15 test files, and none outside tests.
- Not here: a `type: string` arm, an index signature, a transitional `BaseSchema` arm, `BaseSchema`'s own index signature, and the `component` slot's `BaseSchema` fallback (all objectui#8347's). Every zod face and every runtime path stays as it was.

## The accept set, before and after (TypeScript face only)

Judged by `packages/types/src/__tests__/node-slot-union-11466.test.ts`, by the react prop pin, and by the premise probes below.

- **Undeclared `type`, nested or at the prop**, e.g. `{ type: 'card', children: [{ type: 'txt' }] }`. Before: compiles through the `BaseSchema` arm. After: TS2322.
- **A value typed `BaseSchema`** at the prop or in a slot. Before: compiles. After: refused, because it names no declared type.
- **A misspelled key on a closed node type** (an `AuthoringNode`, or a closed `CustomNodeRegistry` entry), nested at any depth. Before: compiles through the `BaseSchema` arm. After: refused, because the slot discriminates on `type`.
- **A misspelled key on a node type that extends `BaseSchema`.** Before: compiles. After: still compiles, through that type's own index signature, until objectui#8347 removes it. This is measured below as the signature-present control leg.
- **A missing REQUIRED key.** Before: compiles through the `BaseSchema` arm. After: refused. Examples: a stored `home` page without `label`, a `data-table` without `columns`.
- **A registered custom type.** Before: any `type` compiled. After: it compiles once declared in `CustomNodeRegistry`; an unregistered one is refused.
- **Narrowing on `type`** (H4). Before (V1 candidate): `'app'` gave `AppComponentSchema | PageDocumentNode` and `'list'` gave `ListSchema | PageDocumentNode`, so an object mixing both arms' keys compiled. After: `'app'` narrows to `PageDocumentNode` (the stored page kind) and `'list'` to `ListSchema`. `PageDocumentNode` excludes the interface-mode `list` kind, which `PageView` renders through `InterfaceListPage` and never hands to `SchemaRenderer`. `SchemaByType` reads `AnySchema` and does not move.

## H1: the cycle

- **Before**, with the V1 candidate on today's base (`tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.json`), there were 9 errors:
  - TS2456 on `FlexBlockNode` (`authoring-nodes.ts`), `AuthoringNode`, `DeclaredNode` and `SchemaNode` (`base.ts`);
  - TS4109 in `zod/base.zod.ts`;
  - TS7022 on `FlexSchema`, `FLEX_BAG_CHILDREN`, `FlexPropsBag` and `FlexBlockSchema` (`zod/layout.zod.ts`).
- **The spelling**, in two parts:
  - `FlexBlockNode` is an interface that extends the closed arm input of `FlexBlockSchema`, with no members of its own. An interface's members resolve lazily, so the union stops referencing itself eagerly. It keeps the same members and stays in `AuthoringNode`.
  - `zod/base.zod.ts` writes the node slot's zod type out through two type aliases (`SchemaNodeZodType`, `NodeSlotZodType`), so `BaseSchemaCore.children` no longer carries a circular type argument. The schema objects themselves do not change.
- **After:** 0 errors in `tsconfig.json` and in `tsconfig.examples.json`.
- **Control:** the interface alone, without the zod aliases, still gives 9 errors with a different shape (TS2456 on `DeclaredNode` and `SchemaNode`, TS2502, TS2313, TS7022). Both parts are needed.

## H3: premise ②

Probe files were thrown away after the run and never committed. There are 40 type-level rows in `@object-ui/types` and 15 in `@object-ui/react`. Each row is labelled OK (must compile) or REFUSE (must error), and each was run on two legs.

- **objectui#8347's P1 mutation** (`BaseSchema`'s index signature deleted; restore proven by blob hash `9c35028e`, equal before and after):
  - types: 40 of 40 rows as labelled. That covers 13 nested-slot rows, 4 prop rows, 7 registry rows, 3 flex-bag rows and 13 H4 rows.
  - react: 15 of 15.
  - So (a) a nested misspelling is refused at every slot depth and at the prop, and (b) a registered custom type is authorable, its misspelling refused, and its keys do not escape onto a declared type.
- **Signature present** (the control, and what lands now):
  - types: 29 of 40; react: 9 of 15.
  - Every row that does not pass is a misspelling on a node type that extends `BaseSchema` (`text`, `statistic`, `button`, `detail-view`, a `BaseSchema`-based registry entry, and a flex child reached through `FlexSchema`'s arm). That is the signature objectui#8347 removes.
  - Undeclared types, wrong-value keys, the tombstone, `AuthoringNode` bag misspellings and unregistered custom types are refused on both legs.
- **(c) timing.** Type instantiations are deterministic. Seconds are medians of 3 runs on a shared box, so read them as ratios:

| program | instantiations (base → V1) | check time (median) |
|---|---|---|
| types `tsconfig.json` | 1,365,802 → 1,369,286 (+0.26%) | 3.04 s → 3.52 s |
| types `tsconfig.examples.json` | 1,181,790 → 1,186,335 (+0.38%) | 3.48 s → 3.66 s |
| types `tsconfig.test.json` | 3,367,386 → 3,379,410 (+0.36%) | 11.90 s → 14.29 s |
| react `tsconfig.json` | 363,198 → 450,194 (+23.95%) | 1.59 s → 1.90 s |
| react `tsconfig.test.json` | 460,816 → 548,440 (+19.01%) | 2.94 s → 3.39 s |
| components `tsconfig.json` | 853,560 → 908,882 (+6.48%) | 5.38 s → 5.23 s |
| components `tsconfig.test.json` | 1,648,395 → 1,744,576 (+5.83%) | 9.73 s → 12.13 s |

  Memory medians moved between -0.9% and +10.4%.

## H2: the census

The instrument is objectui#11479's census, copied. It covers all 88 workspace type-check programs, each run on its own, with V1 applied.

- **Before any consumer edit:** 100 lines in 9 of 88 programs. The card's figure in `5958962553` was 102.
  - react tests 65, components tests 14, layout tests 5, plugin-dashboard tests 5, plugin-dashboard src 4, types tests 4.
  - plugin-form, plugin-gantt and plugin-map tests: 1 each.
- **At `9a491a0a`:** 8 lines in 2 of 88 programs. `ff7f748e` only adds two `.changeset/*.md` notes, which no program reads.
  - plugin-dashboard `tsc --noEmit`: 4 lines.
  - plugin-dashboard `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`: the same 4 lines.
  - The lines are `DashboardGridLayout.tsx` 632 and 685, and `DashboardRenderer.tsx` 1056 and 1097: a `BaseSchema` or `string | BaseSchema` value handed to `SchemaRenderer`.
  - Owner: this card's Q1, held for a decision. These lines are not objectui#8347's.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` reads plugin-dashboard's `dist`. That `dist` was built for the census with census-only casts at those four sites. The casts were then restored, and blob equality with HEAD was checked.

## The corpus, re-judged

- **Type pins restated:**
  - `SchemaRenderer.propsResolution` holds the prop equality and pins that `BaseSchema` is not an arm.
  - `node-recursion-point-8344` reads the measured set of zod arms that no declared node type admits: `app`, `record`, `home`, `utility`, `page`, `dashboard`, `detail-section`, `app-schema-renderer`, `cloud:plan-status`, and the retired kanban arm. Before, it read `never` through `BaseSchema`.
  - `overlay-trigger-union-7081`, `overlay-node-slot-doc-types-7082` and `page-body-arity-8310` move to the declared union.
  - `zod-mirror-parity`'s Wider ledger gains `complex.zod.ts#DashboardComponentSchema` (`widgets`) and `complex.zod.ts#DashboardWidgetSchema` (`component`). Each has a per-arm verdict, and the header now reads 5 entries / 5 keys / 7 arms.
  - `authoring-nodes-11364` gets a dated note.
  - New: `node-slot-union-11466` (shape, no wide arm, `AnySchema` members, app/list narrowing, `SchemaByType`, nested misspelling refused through a closed registry entry).
- **Test fixtures:**
  - react suites that register test-only types now declare them in `CustomNodeRegistry`, the way an application would. That is 13 files.
  - Deliberately undeclared input (unknown or retired types, refused spellings, host values merged into a node) crosses `undeclaredNode`. That is 15 files, including the three flat action suites (`action-button-icon-inputs-11168`, `action-group-menu-inputs-11168`, `action-container-member-params-10290`), which measured as NOT plain authoring fixtures: typed as declared nodes they give 44, 38 and 4 errors.
  - Stored page fixtures gained the `label` the page document requires. The plugin-gantt and plugin-map bag fixtures are annotated with their declared node types.
- **Docs:**
  - 14 documents name the declared node type. A registered custom type is shown declared in `CustomNodeRegistry` (`core/schema-renderer.mdx`).
  - `api/schema-reference.md`'s "component node" section now names `DeclaredNode`. Its `my-widget` code block became a prose pointer, because `check:doc-types` refuses an unregistered type literal in a block.
  - Two blocks are still refused and held, as listed below.
- **Pending changesets:** 9 entries got an append-only dated note in the house form (0 lines removed): `11364`, `8331`, `8908`, `schema-input-bridge-permanent-4622`, `7767`, `11479`, `8572`, `8310`, `11354`. Each read the prop or `SchemaNode` as `BaseSchema` in the present tense, or read the node-recursion pin as `never`. The new entry is `.changeset/11466-node-slot-union.md` (types, react and core `minor`; components `patch`). Its body states the breaking TS meaning, because objectui never declares `major`.

## Needs a decision (held, with the measurements)

1. **Dashboard `object-chart` producer (Q1).** The producer emits 12 chart families. `ObjectChartSchema['chartType']` declares 8 of them, the same in TS and zod. funnel, treemap, sankey, combo and radar are undeclared, although `@objectstack/spec`'s `ChartTypeSchema` (17.5.0) declares all 12 and plugin-charts draws them. Narrowing without a cast therefore needs the object-chart face widened to the spec's families first. That edit is in `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`, outside this card's surface.
2. **Dashboard `object-metric` producer (Q1).** The authored bag's filter is the spec's condition list. The producer carries an ObjectQL/Mongo-dialect filter and broadcasts the dashboard filter over the author's components. Which dialect the bag node gets, and whether the broadcast writes the twin or the bag, is a contract choice.
3. **objectui#11483's closure, step 1.** Retyping the slot-entry callbacks to the slot element type cascades `onWidgetsReorder` into `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `DashboardPreview`, which is outside this card's surface. Steps 2 and 3 depend on step 1.
4. **`content/docs/utilities/vscode-extension.mdx`** shows the Export-to-React generator's output: an unannotated `const schema` whose `type` widens to `string`. Annotating the doc alone would misstate the generator, whose source is in `packages/vscode-extension`, outside this card's surface.
5. **`packages/plugin-detail/README.md`.** `detail-section` is a zod-only arm with no TS type, and so are `app-schema-renderer` and `cloud:plan-status`. `record:activity`'s `items` is a host slot that the node refuses by name.

A partial dashboard patch (Q1 producers plus the step-1 callbacks) was measured, kept out of this branch, and saved with its residue log.

## Gates

Toolchain: Node v22.23.3 from a SHA256-checked nodejs.org tarball, because the container's v22.22.0 fails jsdom 30's engine floor. Heavy runs went through the shared verify lock. HEAD is `ff7f748e`.

- **type-check, all 88 workspace programs** at `9a491a0a`: 86 exit 0, 2 exit 2 (plugin-dashboard, the 8 lines above).
- **vitest, run from the worktree root with repo-relative paths:**
  - Batch A: types, react, core builder, and every reader test of a touched doc or README. 530 files and 13,778 tests passed, on file contents equal to `c6ccffb7` (every file of that commit was modified before the run started).
  - Batch B: components, layout, test-support, and the plugin-form, plugin-gantt, plugin-map and plugin-dashboard suites touched here. 399 files passed and 1 skipped; `page-body-single-node-8310` failed on the README anchor.
  - That anchor was updated in `cd98e0f8`, and its rerun with `page-body-arity-8310` passed (2 files, 21 tests).
  - `9a491a0a` only drops an unused type import, judged by the type-check above.
  - The changeset-reading script suites at `ff7f748e`: 7 files and 324 tests passed.
- **Doc gates at `9a491a0a`:**
  - `check:doc-snippets`: exit 1, "776 of 776 block(s) judged, 2 failed" (items 4 and 5 above).
  - `check:doc-examples`: exit 0.
  - `check:doc-types`: exit 0.
- **At `ff7f748e`:** `check-changeset-no-major` 0, `check-changeset-presence` 0, `check-changeset-fixed` 0, `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0, `check-changeset-overwrite` 0 (report-only), `check:changeset-claims` 0 (report-only), `check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new), `check:control-bytes` 0.
- **eslint, narrowed.** It ran on the 50 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors and 102 warnings, the same as those 48 files at base (2 files are new). The population comes from `eslint.config.js`, which applies `**/*.{ts,tsx}` with `tseslint.configs.recommended` and no parser `project`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide lint is CI's.
- **Not measured:** `check:component-surface-parity` and `check:sdui-registration-pins`, because no registration input moved.
- **`main` has moved 7 commits past this base.** The textual merge is clean (`git merge-tree` exit 0), but bringing `main` in was refused locally, so the semantic interaction was not measured. Likely touch points: objectui#11440's zod `ReportNodeSchema` and objectui#11494's `AppSchemaRendererNodeSchema.schema` against `node-recursion-point-8344`'s measured set, and plugin-dashboard's `DrillDownDrawer`.

## Acceptance notes

- The flex bag's child list now type-checks as `SchemaNode` on the TS face, not `unknown[]`. Under the mutation, a misspelled key on a text child inside a flex bag is refused (probe f03). That answers the carrier note objectui#11468's report left for this card.
- `DeclaredNode` also has same-`type` pairs that are intended: `flex` (`FlexSchema` and `FlexBlockNode`) and the five `object-*` renderer faces next to their authored bag nodes. Both spellings are authorable today.
